#Load data
```{r}
FLIP_Clinical <- read_csv(here("Data/FLIP1_ClinicalData.csv"))

FLIP_MicrobiomeParams <- read_csv(here("Data/Microbiome_Parameters_FLIP_VMET2.csv"))

FLIP_Data <- merge(FLIP_Clinical, FLIP_MicrobiomeParams, by='Sequencing Name')

FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Type` == "Participant sample")

FLIP_Data <- FLIP_Data %>%  mutate(Outcome = case_when(Outcome == "Term" ~ "Term",
                                                    Outcome == "iPTB" ~ "iPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "sPTB" ~ "sPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "SPTB" ~ "sPTB",))

# Omit edge cases of pregnancy with rescue cerclage sampling and T6A and T3.5
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E29')
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E186')
```

### Define a custom plotting theme to use in figure panel subplots
```{r}
theme_custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),  
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
      
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"), 
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),  
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

  }
```

# Data Analysis

### Helper: reproducible caret resampling seeds
Build a caret `seeds` list so every resample fit (and the final model) is reproducible,
including under the parallel back-ends used below, where a single `set.seed()` does not
reach the workers. `n_resamples` is the number of CV resamples; `n_models` the number of
rows in the tuning grid.
```{r}
make_caret_seeds <- function(n_resamples, n_models = 1, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  s <- vector("list", n_resamples + 1)
  for (i in seq_len(n_resamples)) s[[i]] <- sample.int(1e6, n_models)
  s[[n_resamples + 1]] <- sample.int(1e6, 1)
  s
}
```

## Random Forest classifiers
### Discrimination of Lactobacillus-dominant vs L. deplete communities
```{r}
set.seed(325562)

metaboliteColumnIdx <- 41:ncol(FLIP_DESI)

dataset_train <- FLIP_DESI
dataset_train <- dataset_train[, c("CST", colnames(dataset_train)[metaboliteColumnIdx])]
dataset_train <- dataset_train[rowSums(is.na(dataset_train)) < 7, ]

dataset_train$CST[grepl("IV", dataset_train$CST)] <- "IV"
dataset_train$CST[!grepl("IV", dataset_train$CST)] <- "LDom"

dataset_train$CST <- factor(dataset_train$CST, levels=c('LDom', 'IV'))

fit_control <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", repeats=15, classProbs = TRUE,
                          number = 7, summaryFunction=multiClassSummary, 
                          #preProcOptions = c('knnImpute', 'center', 'scale'), 
                          savePredictions=TRUE,
                          seeds = make_caret_seeds(15 * 7, n_models = 1, seed = 325562))

train_x <- dataset_train %>% select(-CST, )
train_y <- dataset_train$CST

CST_Model <- train(x = train_x, y = train_y, method = 'rf', 
                     trControl = fit_control, 
                     preProcess = c('center', 'scale'),
                     ntree = 1000, metric = 'AUC', 
                     tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_x)))))


modelResults <- rbind(CST_Model$results)

write_csv(modelResults, './Results/DESI/RFModel_LDomvsLDepl_Results.csv')

saveRDS(CST_Model, './Results/DESI/RF_LDomModel.rds')
```

## Immune Models
### List of Immune params to look in RF models
```{r}
ImmuneParams <- c("IL6 (DS 1.7)", "IL1B (DS 0.4)", "IL8 (DS x10)", "C1q (AS 0.0335)", "C3a (AS 17.5)", 
                  "C3b (AS 2.3875)", "C4 (AS 0.073)", "Factor H (AS)",
                  "C2 (AS 0.17)", "C4b (AS 0.165)", "C5 (AS 0.4)", "C5a (AS 0.00175)", "Factor D (AS 0.0135)", 
                  "MBL (AS 0.0165)", "MMP-2 (AS 54)", "MMP-8 (AS 17.1)", "MMP-9 (AS)")
```

### Iterate and fit RF regressor model to multiple immune mediators
```{r}
set.seed(2563748)

n_cores <- detectCores() - 1

fitRFModel <- function(marker, dataset) {
  
  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", marker) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("-", "", .)
  
  metaboliteColumnIdx <- 66:ncol(dataset)
  dataset_train <- dataset[, c(marker, colnames(dataset)[metaboliteColumnIdx])]
  colnames(dataset_train)[1] <- 'ImmuneMarker'
  dataset_train[, 1] <- as.numeric(dataset_train[, 1])

  # Drop samples with a missing cytokine measurement (ranger disallows NA in the response)
  dataset_train <- dataset_train[!is.na(dataset_train$ImmuneMarker), ]

  train_x <- dataset_train %>% select(-ImmuneMarker)
  train_y <- dataset_train$ImmuneMarker

  tryCatch({registerDoParallel(cores = n_cores)

    fit_control <- trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
      repeats = 15,   number = 7, summaryFunction = defaultSummary,
      savePredictions = TRUE,
      seeds = make_caret_seeds(15 * 7, n_models = 1, seed = 2563748))
      
    rf_model <- train(x = train_x, y = log(train_y), 
      method = 'ranger', trControl = fit_control, 
      preProcess = c('center', 'scale'), metric = 'RMSE', 
      tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(ncol(train_x) / 3),
        splitrule = "variance", min.node.size = 5),
      num.trees = 1000,   num.threads = n_cores)
    
    stopImplicitCluster()
    registerDoSEQ()
    
    saveRDS(rf_model, here(paste0('./Results/DESI/RF_', clean_name, '.rds')))
    
    return(list(model = rf_model,  results = cbind(Marker = clean_name, 
                                                   rf_model$results)))
  }, error = function(e) {
    stopImplicitCluster()
    registerDoSEQ()
    message(paste("Error for", marker, ":", e$message))
    return(list(model = NULL, results = NULL))
    })
}

all_models <- bplapply(ImmuneParams, FUN = fitRFModel,
  dataset = FLIP_Immune_DESI, BPPARAM = SerialParam())

names(all_models) <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", ImmuneParams) %>%
  gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
  gsub("-", "", .)

all_results <- map_df(all_models, ~.x$results) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rsquared))

all_rf_models <- map(all_models, ~.x$model)

print(all_results)

write_csv(all_results, here('./Results/DESI/RF_ImmuneParams_Results.csv'))
```

### Fit the C1q regressor on its own
C1q was omitted from the earlier multi-marker run, so it has no saved model. Fit only C1q here
(the other 16 are left untouched), then reload every marker model from disk so the panel below
sees all 17.
```{r}
set.seed(2563748)
n_cores <- detectCores() - 1

# fitRFModel() writes Results/DESI/RF_C1q.rds internally.
invisible(fitRFModel("C1q (AS 0.0335)", dataset = FLIP_Immune_DESI))

# Reload every fitted marker model from disk (now including RF_C1q.rds).
rf_files <- list.files(here('Results/DESI'), pattern = '^RF_.*\\.rds$', full.names = TRUE)
rf_files <- rf_files[!grepl('RF_LDomModel', rf_files)]
all_rf_models <- lapply(rf_files, readRDS)
names(all_rf_models) <- gsub('^RF_|\\.rds$', '', basename(rf_files))
```

## Plot
```{r}
# Plotting function to extract CV-predictions and use in RF-regressor scatterplots
plot_cv_predictions <- function(model, marker_name, data,
                                xlab = "log(Observed)", 
                                ylab = "log(Predicted)") {
  
  preds <- model$pred %>%
    filter(Resample %in% grep("Rep01", unique(Resample), value = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(sample_idx = rowIndex) %>%
    left_join(data %>% 
        mutate(sample_idx = row_number()) %>%
        select(sample_idx, CST),
      by = "sample_idx")
  
  r2 <- cor(preds$obs, preds$pred)^2
  
  p <- ggplot(preds, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = CST), 
      alpha = 0.7, 
      size = 2.5,
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
      col = "firebrick4", 
      linetype = "dashed", 
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cst_colors, name = "CST") +
    annotate("text", 
      x = min(preds$obs), 
      y = max(preds$pred),
      label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 3)),
      hjust = 0, 
      vjust = 1, 
      size = 6) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_custom_plot()
  
  return(p)}
```

## Univariate analysis of individual markers
### Load features previously annoted in Pruski et al 2021
```{r}
immuneFeatures <- read_csv(here('./Data/Immune_Features_DESI.csv'))
microbiomeFeatures <- read_csv(here('./Data/Microbiota_Features_DESI.csv'))

mz_columns <- colnames(FLIP_DESI)[41:ncol(FLIP_DESI)]
mz_values <- as.numeric(mz_columns)

find_closest_mz <- function(theoretical_mz, mz_values, mz_columns, ppm_tolerance = 15) {
  
  ppm_errors <- abs((mz_values - theoretical_mz) / theoretical_mz * 1e6)
  
  min_ppm <- min(ppm_errors)
  
  if (min_ppm <= ppm_tolerance) {
    best_idx <- which.min(ppm_errors)
    return(list(matched_column = mz_columns[best_idx],  
      matched_mz = mz_values[best_idx],        
      ppm_error = min_ppm))
  } else {
    return(list(matched_column = NA_character_,
      matched_mz = NA_real_,
      ppm_error = NA_real_))}}


## Match microbiome Features
microbiomeFeatures <- microbiomeFeatures %>%
  select(c(`Metabolite Annotation`, `Theoretical m/z` ,`Adduct`, `Elevated in`)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(match_result = list(find_closest_mz(`Theoretical m/z`, mz_values, mz_columns, ppm_tolerance = 15))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% unnest_wider(match_result)

microbiomeFeatures <- microbiomeFeatures %>%
  filter(!is.na(matched_column))

microbiomeFeatures$Signature <- 'Microbiome'

## Match Immune Features
immuneFeatures <- immuneFeatures %>%
  select(c(`Metabolite Annotation`, `m/z theoretical` ,Adduct)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`m/z theoretical`)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(match_result = list(find_closest_mz(`m/z theoretical`, mz_values, mz_columns, ppm_tolerance = 15))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% unnest_wider(match_result)

immuneFeatures <- immuneFeatures %>%
  filter(!is.na(matched_column))

immuneFeatures$Signature <- 'Immune'
immuneFeatures <- immuneFeatures %>% rename(`Theoretical m/z` = `m/z theoretical`)


allFeatures <- microbiomeFeatures %>% bind_rows(immuneFeatures)

# Save the matched features
write_csv(allFeatures, here('./Results/matched_DESI_MS_Features.csv'))
```

## Analysis of metabolic shifts with CST transition from T0 to T1. 
```{r}
FLIP_Paired_T0T1 <- FLIP_DESI %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`) %>%
  filter(all(c("T0", "T1") %in% Timepoint)) %>%
  mutate(CST_T0 = CST[Timepoint == "T0"],
    CST_T1 = CST[Timepoint == "T1"],
    CST_changed = CST_T0 != CST_T1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1")) %>% 
  mutate(CST_changed = case_when(CST_changed == TRUE ~ "CST Transition",
          CST_changed == FALSE ~ "Stable CST"))

FLIP_Paired_T0T1$CST_changed <- factor(FLIP_Paired_T0T1$CST_changed, levels=c("Stable CST", "CST Transition"))

FLIP_CST_changers <- FLIP_Paired_T0T1 %>%
  select(`FLIP number`, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST, names_prefix = "CST_") %>%
  mutate(CST_changed = CST_T0 != CST_T1)

FLIP_Paired_T0T1_annotated <- FLIP_Paired_T0T1 %>%
  left_join(FLIP_CST_changers, by = "FLIP number") 

# Get m/z features
mz_features <- colnames(FLIP_DESI)[41:ncol(FLIP_DESI)]

FLIP_long_format_CST_changers <- FLIP_Paired_T0T1 %>%
  filter(CST_changed == "CST Transition") %>%
  select(`FLIP number`, Timepoint, all_of(mz_features)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(mz_features),
    names_to = "feature", 
    values_to = "intensity")

wilcox_results_DESI_CSTChange <- FLIP_long_format_CST_changers %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  wilcox_test(intensity ~ Timepoint, 
              paired = TRUE) %>%  
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

# join with annotated features
wilcox_annotated_DESI_CSTChange <- wilcox_results_DESI_CSTChange %>%
  left_join(allFeatures %>% select(matched_column, `Metabolite Annotation`, 
                                   `Theoretical m/z`, ppm_error, Signature, `Elevated in`),
    by = c("feature" = "matched_column")) %>%
  write_csv(here('./Results/DESI_CST_T0_T1.csv')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Metabolite Annotation`)) %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

# Save the annotated CST-transition metabolites (all results, annotated features only)
write_csv(wilcox_annotated_DESI_CSTChange, here('./Results/DESI_CST_T0_T1_Metabolites.csv'))
```

```{r}
# Custom functions to control subplots and significance brackets.
desi_signif_layer <- function(data, mz_col) {
  d2 <- data %>% dplyr::arrange(`FLIP number`, Timepoint)
  d2$paired_val <- log(as.numeric(d2[[mz_col]]) + 1)
  stat <- tryCatch(
    d2 %>%
      dplyr::group_by(CST_changed) %>%
      rstatix::wilcox_test(paired_val ~ Timepoint, paired = TRUE) %>%
      rstatix::add_significance() %>%
      rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Timepoint") %>%
      dplyr::filter(p.signif != "ns"),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(stat) || nrow(stat) == 0) return(NULL)
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(stat, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 3.5)
}
```

# Leave-Group-Out (by pregnancy) Random Forest models
Re-analysis of the models in the previous sections using grouped  (`FLIP number`) cross-validation.
### Helper function for pregnancy-grouped CV fold
```{r}
make_group_folds <- function(groups, k = 7, repeats = 15, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  n <- length(groups)
  uniq <- unique(groups)
  index <- list()
  indexOut <- list()
  for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
    fold_of_group <- sample(rep_len(seq_len(k), length(uniq)))  
    names(fold_of_group) <- as.character(uniq)
    grp_fold <- fold_of_group[as.character(groups)]
    for (f in seq_len(k)) {
      nm <- sprintf("Rep%02d.Fold%d", r, f)
      test_rows <- which(grp_fold == f)
      index[[nm]] <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_rows)  
      indexOut[[nm]] <- test_rows                    
    }
  }
  list(index = index, indexOut = indexOut)
}
```

## LGO Random Forest classifier
### Discrimination of Lactobacillus-dominant vs L. deplete communities (grouped CV)
```{r}
set.seed(325562)

metaboliteColumnIdx <- 41:ncol(FLIP_DESI)

dataset_train <- FLIP_DESI
dataset_train <- dataset_train[, c("CST", colnames(dataset_train)[metaboliteColumnIdx])]

keep <- rowSums(is.na(dataset_train)) < 7
dataset_train <- dataset_train[keep, ]
group_vec <- FLIP_DESI$`FLIP number`[keep]

dataset_train$CST[grepl("IV", dataset_train$CST)] <- "IV"
dataset_train$CST[!grepl("IV", dataset_train$CST)] <- "LDom"

dataset_train$CST <- factor(dataset_train$CST, levels=c('LDom', 'IV'))

folds <- make_group_folds(group_vec, k = 7, repeats = 15, seed = 325562)

fit_control <- trainControl(index = folds$index, indexOut = folds$indexOut,
                          classProbs = TRUE, summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
                          savePredictions = TRUE,
                          seeds = make_caret_seeds(length(folds$index), n_models = 1, seed = 325562))

train_x <- dataset_train %>% select(-CST, )
train_y <- dataset_train$CST

CST_Model_LGO <- train(x = train_x, y = train_y, method = 'rf',
                     trControl = fit_control,
                     preProcess = c('center', 'scale'),
                     ntree = 1000, metric = 'AUC',
                     tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_x)))))


modelResults_LGO <- rbind(CST_Model_LGO$results)

write_csv(modelResults_LGO, './Results/DESI/RFModel_LDomvsLDepl_Results_LGO.csv')
```

### LGO ROC AUC
```{r}
target <- 'IV'

cv_original_class_LGO <- CST_Model_LGO$pred$obs
cv_predictor_avg_LGO <- CST_Model_LGO$pred[, target]
roc_CST_LGO <- roc(cv_original_class_LGO, cv_predictor_avg_LGO, ci = TRUE, direction = "<")

roc_ci_LGO <- as.numeric(ci(roc_CST_LGO))  # lower, AUC, upper

roc_summary_LGO <- data.frame(
  AUC = as.numeric(roc_CST_LGO$auc),
  CI_lower = roc_ci_LGO[1],
  CI_upper = roc_ci_LGO[3])

write_csv(roc_summary_LGO, './Results/DESI/RFModel_LDomvsLDepl_ROC_LGO.txt')

print(roc_summary_LGO)
```

## LGO Immune Models
### Iterate and fit LGO RF regressor to multiple immune mediators
```{r}
set.seed(2563748)

n_cores <- detectCores() - 1

# Folds are built inside the fitting function (below) from the NA-filtered group vector, so
# they always align to the rows actually used for training a given marker.

fitRFModel_LGO <- function(marker, dataset, group_col = "FLIP number",
                           k = 7, repeats = 15, fold_seed = 2563748) {

  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", marker) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("-", "", .)

  metaboliteColumnIdx <- 66:ncol(dataset)
  dataset_train <- dataset[, c(marker, colnames(dataset)[metaboliteColumnIdx])]
  colnames(dataset_train)[1] <- 'ImmuneMarker'
  dataset_train[, 1] <- as.numeric(dataset_train[, 1])
  group_vec <- dataset[[group_col]]

  # Drop samples with a missing cytokine measurement (ranger disallows NA in the response),
  # keeping the pregnancy grouping aligned so grouped folds are built on the same rows.
  keep <- !is.na(dataset_train$ImmuneMarker)
  dataset_train <- dataset_train[keep, ]
  group_vec <- group_vec[keep]

  train_x <- dataset_train %>% select(-ImmuneMarker)
  train_y <- dataset_train$ImmuneMarker

  folds <- make_group_folds(group_vec, k = k, repeats = repeats, seed = fold_seed)

  tryCatch({registerDoParallel(cores = n_cores)

    fit_control <- trainControl(index = folds$index, indexOut = folds$indexOut,
      summaryFunction = defaultSummary, savePredictions = TRUE,
      seeds = make_caret_seeds(length(folds$index), n_models = 1, seed = 2563748))

    rf_model <- train(x = train_x, y = log(train_y),
      method = 'ranger', trControl = fit_control,
      preProcess = c('center', 'scale'), metric = 'RMSE',
      tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(ncol(train_x) / 3),
        splitrule = "variance", min.node.size = 5),
      num.trees = 1000,   num.threads = n_cores)

    stopImplicitCluster()
    registerDoSEQ()

    return(list(model = rf_model,  results = cbind(Marker = clean_name,
                                                   rf_model$results)))
  }, error = function(e) {
    stopImplicitCluster()
    registerDoSEQ()
    message(paste("Error for", marker, ":", e$message))
    return(list(model = NULL, results = NULL))
    })
}

all_models_lgo <- bplapply(ImmuneParams, FUN = fitRFModel_LGO,
  dataset = FLIP_Immune_DESI, BPPARAM = SerialParam())

names(all_models_lgo) <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", ImmuneParams) %>%
  gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
  gsub("-", "", .)

all_results_lgo <- map_df(all_models_lgo, ~.x$results) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rsquared))

print(all_results_lgo)

write_csv(all_results_lgo, here('./Results/DESI/RF_ImmuneParams_Results_LGO.csv'))
```
